player_prompt.intro:
Droeueuh Player {player_id} ({role}) lam permainan Matching Pennies {num_rounds}-ronde.
- Tiap ronde, kirim [heads] atawa [tails] (atawa [h], [t]).
- Jika pilihan droeueuh sama ngon lawan, Player 0 meunang ronde nyan; laen ngon Player 1 meunang.
Jawab ngon pilihan droeueuh lam format '[heads]' atawa '[tails]'.

message.round_match: Peumeurah 0 geutôh {choice0}; Peumeurah 1 geutôh {choice1}. Seumôh -> Peumeurah 0 meunang
message.round_mismatch: Peumeurah 0 geutôh {choice0}; Peumeurah 1 geutôh {choice1}. Hana seumôh -> Peumeurah 1 meunang
